## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or capability.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation?
> *e.g., "I'm always frustrated when..." or "Coordinators currently have no easy way to..."*

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented. Include UX flows, workflow diagrams, or conceptual mockups where applicable.

## Target User Persona / Stakeholder
- [ ] Public Visitors / Prospective Delegates
- [ ] Registered Student Participants
- [ ] Faculty & Student Event Coordinators
- [ ] Hospitality / Food Coordinators
- [ ] Fest Administrators & IQAC / NAAC Documentation Committee

## Proposed Technical Scope
- [ ] UI / Component Changes
- [ ] New Route or Page
- [ ] API Route / Server Action
- [ ] Prisma Schema Update / DB Migration
- [ ] Email Service / Scheduler / Notification
- [ ] PDF / Dossier Export / Print Engine

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context & Mockups
Add any other context, wireframes, or reference materials here.
